nom: e.l.f. SKIN Thirst Burst Pore-fecting Toner

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are mostly positive, saying it hydrates without stripping and outperforms pricier brands, though one reviewer found it too drying for her winter skin when combined with a retinol.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one in her 70s, consistently report no burning, redness, or flare-ups, with only a brief, seconds-long tingle noted by one reviewer immediately after application.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the salicylic acid keeps breakouts in check and clears congestion in the T-zone while still keeping cheeks comfortably hydrated, without making oiliness worse.
segments.mature: The two reviewers describing mature or aging skin report a hydrated, glass-like glow and better results than pricier alternatives they'd tried, with one noting it doesn't burn the way other brands' clarifying formulas did on her 70-year-old skin.

concerns.aging: The limited comments on aging skin focus on hydration and glow rather than a specific anti-wrinkle effect, with one 70-year-old reviewer noting the skin around her pores looked firmer after starting use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, report it hydrates without stripping or tightness, often noting their moisturizer seems to lock in better afterward; the exception is a reviewer who found it too drying for her winter-dry skin when paired with a retinol.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report no burning or redness, including several who call themselves sensitive; the only irritation noted anywhere is a brief tingle right after application that one reviewer says fades within seconds.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report visibly fewer blackheads, especially around the nose, and fewer breakouts with continued use; no reviewer in this set reports the product causing new breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Cap or seal can arrive loose and leak
Some find it thicker or slightly stickier than a typical toner
Strong value compared to pricier BHA toners

extraits.texte: I really like the new products ELF has come out with. I think they are great quality for the price. This toner was a bit too much for my dryer winter skin. I think it will work well in the summer but was a bit too drying given the season as well as that I use a retinol. It was quick and easy to apply. My biggest complaint on this was that there is no seal between the bottle and the cap. My bottle arrived with a loose cap and about 20% of the toner had leaked from the bottle... so not great.

extraits.titre: Super Find!!!  Love it.  Age 70 - and sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I’m 70 …… hardly a wrinkle on my face ( satay out of the sun ladies) I used to use all Clinique and their Clarifying lotion. Well, Non of their clarifying lotions work on 70 year old skin. It actually burns. But this is lovely!!! Feels so good and starting out with every other night. Take away the cotton balls - they soak up too much. I put a few drops directly on the area and spread it with my right ring finger ( don’t ever pull your skin!). Feels SO refreshing and clean. After it’s really had time to soak in and dry, I use some Clinique ( Dramatically different moistening lotion) - just a bit on the dry areas of my face. And neck. Love this! It’s already firming up the couple places I’m starting to see pores. Nose, inside of cheeks, bit on chin and on my forehead- not because of pores - but just because it feels so good! I’ll come back and add to post if anything changes.

Does anyone else remember when e.l.f. was like the super cheap makeup brand that you only bought when you needed to use something once or twice and didn't want to spend a fortune? This is not that e.l.f. anymore. Their stuff has come a LONG way, and I'm so so impressed by the quality of their products. I recently started using their makeup primer and setting spray and LOVE them both. When this toner popped up, I pretty quickly ordered it because I had faith that it would be good based on other recently-used products. I LOVE this toner. Truly. I've been using it for several weeks, and it's so good. I get really bad blackheads on my nose, and this stuff has eradicated almost all of them. I use it just at night right now (directions say twice a day, but I wanted to start out slow). It has pretty much no smell. Nothing perfumy or overwhelming. It goes on my face nicely with a cotton pad and soaks in quickly. Doesn't dry out my skin or cause a rash. I will 100% order this again!

I’ve really enjoyed using the e.l.f. Thirst Burst Pore‑fecting Toner, it’s become a refreshing step in my skincare routine that genuinely feels effective and hydrating. Right away, the texture stood out: it’s lightweight and almost gel‑like, so it glides over my skin smoothly without any sticky or tight feeling. The scent is very mild and clean, which I appreciate because it never irritates my nose or skin, and there’s no heavy fragrance competing with my serums or moisturizer. What I love most is how this toner balances hydration with gentle exfoliation. The formula feels instantly cooling and plumping as I swipe it on, and over the past few weeks I’ve noticed my skin looks more even and refreshed. My pores appear a bit smaller and my overall texture feels smoother, especially on days when my skin tends to be dull or congested. The addition of salicylic acid works well for my combination skin: it helps keep breakouts at bay and gently exfoliates without ever drying me out, while the hydrating ingredients make my skin feel soft rather than stripped. I also like that it’s vegan and cruelty‑free, it aligns with my preference for skincare that feels kind to both skin and conscience. In terms of value for the price, I feel like this toner delivers a lot: it’s versatile enough to use morning and night, layers well under serums and moisturizers, and has noticeably improved the look and feel of my skin. This toner strikes a great balance of hydration, exfoliation, and pore‑smoothing

extraits.titre: Best value toner for dry skin.
extraits.texte: I am very happy with this toner, it is perfect for my dry skin, leaving it clean, fresh, and toned without drying it out. Excellent value, works better than the more expensive brands I’ve used in the past.

extraits.titre: Literally the best skincare product I have used in a long time!!!!
extraits.texte: Elf has been one of my favorite drugstore brands for years so I jumped at ordering the Thirst Burst Pore-fecting Toner as soon as I saw it. I used their makeup first for years and have tried a few of their skincare products and I have to say, I have never been disappointed despite previously being such a luxury brand snob. I have been waiting for years for there to be a dupe for a certain brand that also has a 2% BHA liquid exfoliant. That brand has become more and more expensive and though I have seen other liquid exfoliants pop up, I have literally waited for two decades for there to be one more affordable with salicylic acid. And the fact that it is Elf to make it, makes me so happy! It is a clear liquid and it works perfectly for the toner step. I follow it with an essence and then serum and moisturizer. I love how short the ingredient list is. I am allergic to niacinamide and it is in so much skincare these days but not in this one! My skin does not burn or turn red after use and since I have become very sensitive, I can say this is sensitive skin friendly! There are also hydrating ingredients so your skin doesn't dry out. And for the price!!! Are you kidding me, Elf!?!?! This product is better than I could have ever dreamed of! If you have oily skin, want to keep your pores clear and get rid of any congestion or texture, you need this!

I've been using this toner once a week for about 3 weeks now, too harsh for me to use daily. It goes on silky smooth, lightweight and dries quickly. I have sensitive skin and there is a mild tingle right after putting it on but goes away after a few seconds. No tightness, no sticky feeling, no face turning red from irritation. Before this toner I've tried a couple others. Never really saw or understood the benefits, I just felt like I was wiping water on my face. But this one I love and can clearly see and feel the difference! Since using this one I've noticed my moisturizer seems to lock in better and wake up with my face still feeling soft. My pores are less noticeable and have not had as many blackheads around my nose & chin. Great quality and value for the price, it's a 4oz bottle but only using once a week it should last me a long time.
